constraints: two to four terms; integer coefficients from -9 to 9
hints: Find the pieces joined by addition or subtraction outside parentheses. Keep each piece with its sign.
A coefficient is the signed number multiplying a variable; a constant has no variable. A letter written alone has coefficient one.
Check whether the question asks for a count, a coefficient, or a constant, then give that requested part with its sign.

constraints: at most two variables; exponents <= 2
hints: Look at each term's letters and powers. Like terms must have the same letters raised to the same powers.
Select the matching terms, keeping their signs. Their numerical coefficients can differ.
If asked for their sum, add the signed coefficients and keep the shared variable part. Otherwise give the requested matching term or comparison.

objective: Substitute one value into a linear expression
constraints: one variable; positive integer inputs; coefficients <= 9
hints: Replace the variable everywhere with the given value, using parentheses around the replacement.
Do the multiplication before the addition or subtraction. Keep the quantities in the original order.
Check each replacement and sign against the original expression, then finish the calculation.

constraints: two variables; positive integer inputs <= 10
hints: Match each letter to its own value and replace every occurrence, including repeated letters.
Calculate inside parentheses first. Then do multiplication and division before any outside addition or subtraction.
Check that you used both given values in the right places and kept the original order of subtraction or division.

constraints: exponents <= 2; positive inputs
hints: Replace every letter with its value. Find the complete base of each power, including any parentheses around it.
Calculate inside a grouped base before raising it to its power. Square by multiplying that whole base by itself.
Finish the remaining multiplication, division, addition, and subtraction in order. Check that an outside factor was kept outside the power.

objective: Negative inputs with order of operations
constraints: inputs in -9..9; watch sign of squared negatives
hints: Put each substituted value in parentheses and preserve the original grouping, including the numerator of a fraction.
Calculate within groups using the order of operations. Raise the complete indicated base to its power before applying any minus outside that power.
Finish multiplication and division before addition and subtraction. Check every original sign and every substituted value.

objective: Multi-term expressions with negatives and exponents
constraints: three terms; inputs in -9..9; distinguish -x^2 from (-x)^2
hints: Substitute every value in parentheses. Mark which quantity each exponent applies to.
Evaluate grouped bases and powers first, then the products in each term. Keep a minus outside a power separate from its base.
Combine the three signed term values. Check that each original term, variable, and sign appears in your calculation.

constraints: one operation; single variable
hints: Identify the letter for the unknown and the other quantity in the phrase.
A sum or an amount more than a quantity calls for addition. For the difference of two quantities, subtract the second from the first.
Read your expression back in words. Check that any subtraction uses the order named in the phrase.

constraints: one operation; single variable
hints: Identify the two quantities and whether the phrase asks for their product or quotient.
Multiply for a product. For the quotient of two quantities, divide the first named quantity by the second.
Read the expression back. For division, check that the denominator is the quantity being divided by.

constraints: two operations; watch order-reversing phrases (less than, fewer than)
hints: Find the quantity that must be built first, such as a multiple of the variable or a quotient.
An amount less than that quantity is subtracted from it; an amount more than it is added to it.
Use parentheses when an operation applies to an entire sum or difference. Read back both operations to check their order.

objective: Expression from a table of values
constraints: linear patterns with positive integer step; check against the first entry
hints: Compare two table entries. Divide the change in output by the change in input to find the increase per input unit.
Multiply that rate by the variable. Find the constant by subtracting rate times a known input from its listed output.
Add the constant to your variable term. Substitute the first listed input and another input to check that both outputs match.

constraints: start value plus constant rate; single variable
hints: Identify what the variable counts, how much each extra unit adds, and the count where the starting amount is given.
Start with that known amount and add the rate times the number of extra units. From a first item, extra units are the total count minus one.
Simplify the expression and test the given starting count and one later count. For a fee charged at zero use, the variable counts all units of use.

constraints: whole-number inputs; area/perimeter formulas
hints: Identify each formula variable and supplied value.
Substitute with parentheses and calculate in formula order.
Check the result has the appropriate unit.

constraints: inputs chosen so fraction coefficients produce whole numbers
hints: Identify each formula variable and supplied value.
Substitute with parentheses and calculate in formula order.
Check the result has the appropriate unit.

objective: Combine like terms with positive coefficients
constraints: single variable; positive coefficients <= 9
hints: Group only terms with identical variable parts and exponents.
Add or subtract coefficients while keeping signs.
Leave unlike terms separate and check every term was used.

constraints: results may be negative; single variable
hints: Group only terms with identical variable parts and exponents.
Add or subtract coefficients while keeping signs.
Leave unlike terms separate and check every term was used.

constraints: two variable types plus constants; keep unlike terms separate
hints: Group only terms with identical variable parts and exponents.
Add or subtract coefficients while keeping signs.
Leave unlike terms separate and check every term was used.

objective: Distribute a positive factor over a sum
constraints: positive factor; two-term binomial
hints: Multiply the outside factor by every term in parentheses.
Carry a negative sign to each product when needed.
Then combine matching terms.

constraints: negative factor or leading minus; watch both signs
hints: Include the sign in the outside factor. A minus directly before parentheses means multiplying the whole group by negative one.
Multiply that signed factor by every term inside, including each term's sign.
Check each product and its sign separately. Substitute a value into the original expression and your expansion to check the calculation.

constraints: combine after distributing; single variable
hints: Write the starting expression with its grouping. When subtracting an expression, put that entire expression in parentheses.
Multiply each signed outside factor by every term in its group. Then gather matching variable terms and gather constants.
Combine each group of like terms with its signs. Check that every original term contributed once, including terms after a leading minus.

constraints: two terms; GCF between 2 and 9; verify by expanding
hints: Find a greatest common factor shared by every term.
Place it outside parentheses and divide each term by it inside.
Expand to check coefficients and signs.

objective: Factor with negatives and two variables
constraints: GCF may be negative; expand to check both signs
hints: Find the greatest common factor of the numerical coefficients. Use the sign of the outside factor specified by the question.
Divide every signed term by that same signed factor, keeping each variable with its quotient.
Write the factor outside parentheses and the quotients inside. Multiply back into both terms to check their coefficients and signs.

constraints: one expression simplifies (or fails to) into the other; single variable
hints: Expand any grouped products and combine like terms in each expression. Keep different variable powers separate.
Compare the signed coefficient of each variable power and compare the constants. Equivalent expressions have matching simplified terms.
A value that gives different results disproves equivalence. A single matching result is insufficient: use the simplified expressions to check agreement for every allowed value.

objective: Simplify to a standard equivalent form
constraints: distribute and combine; integer coefficients
hints: Write the expression described by the problem, using the relevant formula if a shape is involved.
Distribute every signed factor to all terms in its parentheses. Combine matching variable terms, and combine constants separately.
Arrange the result in the requested form, keeping the coefficient with its variable. Check that expanding and collecting preserved every original term.
